title.narrative: Políticas públicas y marco regulatorio que promuevan la inversión hacia una transición económica verde y sostenible en el Perú

description.narrative: Contract related to: Políticas públicas y marco regulatorio que promuevan la inversión hacia una transición económica verde y sostenible en el Perú - The country economic recovery must address, not only the social cohesion long lasting situation but also the challenges of climate change, ecosystem degradation and the necessary transition towards a circular economy. This involves the development of enabling conditions such as the creation of legal, social, financial, and economic frameworks that promote circular economic models, sustainable value chains and climate-resilient investments.Ignoring those frameworks would lead to unsustainable and vulnerable value chains, suboptimal use of resources and an increase in waste generation, both solid and liquid, negatively impacting the environment and public health.Regarding the financial frameworks, Peru developed ¿ with the support of the EU ¿ a ¿National plan for the transition towards circular economy¿ and a ¿Green Finance Roadmap¿, which is a key instrument to facilitate a gradual transition towards green finance by requiring that entities in the financial, insurance and securities market systems incorporate environmental considerations in their strategic, operational, and reporting management.The EU is recognized as a benchmark and a key partner in the field of sustainable green investments and the circular economy. It is currently implementing the action `Sustainable Business - A Circular, Inclusive Economy¿ which aims to support Peru¿s transition towards a more inclusive green economic growth path. Therefore, based on its experience and the confidence created with the public administration in the EU¿s added value and potential impact on the country sustainable growth, as well as its crucial role in the fight against climate change, the MIP 2021-2027 includes green transition within Priority Area 1 Circular Transition, encompassing the circular economy, sustainable and climate security for inclusive and gender-sensitive investments and support to key infrastructure development. Consequently, this action aligns with Peru¿s efforts in implementing green finance (designing and launching green bonds, loans and equity instruments), adopting a sustainable green taxonomy inspired by the existing European taxonomy, and improving enabling conditions for solid waste management, recycling and reusing, as well as the rational management of water resources (water resources protection (surface and underground), clean water access and infrastructure, used water and sanitation infrastructures), both with important consequences on people health and economic development (both in urban and rural areas). This action will also contribute actively to support Peru in adapting its public policies and regulations as requested by the SDGs and the OECD in the areas of intervention of this project.The action is strategically implemented at different levels: -At National level, the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Ministry of Environment and the Ministry of Housing, Construction and Sanitation are in charge of defining the national policy in their areas and coordinate action to develop or improve the enabling conditions for the implementation of the Green Finance Roadmap, the National Circular Economy Roadmap and the sectoral Circular Economy Roadmaps. -At local level, the provincial and local municipalities are in charge of defining the objectives to be attained in line with the central government strategy, the needs of the population, adopting the necessary norms, defining the governance of the actions and infrastructures to be implemented in orde
